name: Signature Shiny
wearing: a layered, ethereal outfit of sheer, frosted {{PRIMARY}} fabric over a matte underlayer, with delicate {{MAGIC}} glowing fibre-optic threads woven throughout, secured at the shoulders, no headwear, her hair fully visible; a thin bikini-style top and a short, skimpy, intricate bottom with a few short fringes hanging down, the whole outfit translucent so the shape beneath is softly visible
pose: She stands with weight shifted, one arm bent at the elbow, her hand cupped with a ball of crackling {{MAGIC}} lightning fusing in her palm as she casts; her other hand rests on an ornate staff planted at her side. Her gaze is direct and focused on the camera, her expression composed with a quiet, knowing smile.
holding: a tall ornate staff, upright, touching the ground, topped with an open ring-shaped summoning sigil of etched {{PRIMARY}} metal, a ball of crackling {{MAGIC}} lightning suspended in the ring
effects: Soft gradient lightning strikes flicker in the air around her, diffused studio light catching the fibre-optic threads woven through her outfit. A fine prismatic glitter and a gilded, holographic shimmer play across the metal, the fabric and the magic, every glow edged with a rainbow sheen.

components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Fulgora, visible through the castle hall's high windows, electric-gold and arc-white scales, wings like sheets of storm-cloud laced with lightning

notes: SHINY variant of the Signature: same scene and pose in a prismatic, gilded colourway with a holographic glitter sheen. Convention: <slug>-scene-signature-shiny.
